# Content model

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/content-model-docs.mjs from the JSDoc in src/content-types and the examples in src/fixtures/blocks. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:content-model`. A unit test fails when this file is out of date. -->

This file is **generated**. Field descriptions come from the JSDoc in [`src/content-types/blocks.ts`](../src/content-types/blocks.ts) and [`shared.ts`](../src/content-types/shared.ts); examples come from [`src/fixtures/blocks/`](../src/fixtures/blocks). Only the modelling guidance below is hand-written (inside the generator).

The content model is plain JSON: no functions, React nodes or `Date` objects (dates are ISO 8601 strings). A CMS adapter maps CMS entries to `PageContent`; `<BlockRenderer>` maps each block to a component through the registry. Length limits mentioned below are guidance, not validation.

> **Warning: this library does NOT sanitize HTML.** `RichText.html` is inserted into the page as-is. Your adapter (or host app) must sanitize it with an allow-list of tags and attributes before producing a `RichText` value. The renderer only neutralizes unsafe URLs (`javascript:`, `data:` and similar link and image targets); it does not remove scripts, event handler attributes, inline styles or iframes.

## Modelling guidance

- **One CMS content type per block type.** Keep CMS field names free; the adapter renames them. Do not model layout (columns, colours) as free text: use the enumerated values listed per block.
- **Ids.** Every block needs an `id` unique within the page (CMS entry ids work well). `anchorId` is optional and separate: authors set it for `#links`; it must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, `-` and `_`.
- **Headings are automatic.** Authors never pick heading levels. The first `hero` or `pageHeader` on a page renders the `h1`; every other block heading is `h2`, and items inside blocks are `h3`. Start each page with a `hero` or `pageHeader`.
- **Images need alt text.** `ImageRef.alt` is required. Use `""` only for decorative images (avatars beside a name, logos beside the company name). Image `src` must be relative or http(s).
- **Links.** Allowed: relative URLs, `http(s):`, `mailto:` and `tel:`. Anything else (`javascript:`, `data:`, …) is reported by `validatePage`, and the renderer shows the link text without a link.
- **Rich text** is `{ format: "html", html }`. The adapter must produce sanitized HTML from an allow-list (see `src/adapters/example-cms`); the renderer additionally strips unsafe URLs but is not a full sanitizer.
- **Money** is integer minor units plus an ISO currency code (`{ "amount": 4900, "currency": "USD" }` is $49). `price: null` means "contact us".
- **Forms** (`contactForm`, `newsletterSignup`) are content only. They become interactive when the host app passes handlers in `BlockRenderer`’s `context.forms`; otherwise they render as an inert preview.
- **Tabs** may contain rich text or blocks, one level deep (no tabs inside tabs).
- **Validate before publishing.** Run `validatePage(page)` in CMS preview or CI; errors make a block render as nothing (or a placeholder with `showErrors`).

## Page

A page: metadata plus an ordered list of blocks.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | CMS entry id. |
| `slug` | `string` | yes | URL slug without leading slash, e.g. "about" or "blog/five-day-close"; "" for the home page. |
| `template` | `string` | no | Page template name; interpreted by the host app (e.g. "landing", "article"). |
| `seo` | `SeoMeta` | yes | Metadata. |
| `blocks` | `Block[]` | yes | Blocks in display order. Ids unique within the page. |

## Fields on every block

Fields every block has.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Unique within the page. Used for React keys and error reports. |
| `type` | `string` | yes | Block type discriminator; selects the registry definition. |
| `anchorId` | `string` | no | Becomes the section's id for #anchor links. Letters, digits, - and _; must start with a letter. |
| `background` | `'default' \| 'subtle' \| 'accent' \| 'inverse'` | no | Section background. Default "default". |
| `padding` | `'none' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | no | Vertical padding of the section. Each block type has a sensible default. |

Allowed values: `background`: `default`, `subtle`, `accent`, `inverse`; `padding`: `none`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`.

## Blocks

- [`hero`](#hero): Page-opening block with a headline, subhead, up to two actions and optional media.
- [`pageHeader`](#pageheader): Top of a content page: title, description, breadcrumbs, author and actions.
- [`featureGrid`](#featuregrid): Grid of short features with optional icons and links.
- [`cardGrid`](#cardgrid): Grid of equal-height cards.
- [`articleCardGrid`](#articlecardgrid): Grid of article teasers (blog index, related posts).
- [`mediaText`](#mediatext): Image beside text with optional actions.
- [`ctaBanner`](#ctabanner): Call-to-action panel.
- [`stats`](#stats): Key figures.
- [`testimonial`](#testimonial): A single large testimonial.
- [`testimonialGrid`](#testimonialgrid): Two or three testimonials as cards.
- [`logoStrip`](#logostrip): Row of customer or partner logos.
- [`faq`](#faq): Frequently asked questions as an accordion.
- [`pricingTable`](#pricingtable): Pricing tiers with an optional monthly/annual toggle.
- [`richText`](#richtext): Long-form rich text.
- [`gallery`](#gallery): Image gallery with optional lightbox.
- [`videoEmbed`](#videoembed): Click-to-load video. Nothing loads from the provider until the visitor presses play.
- [`mapEmbed`](#mapembed): Click-to-load map with an address and directions link.
- [`team`](#team): Team member grid.
- [`timeline`](#timeline): Ordered events.
- [`steps`](#steps): A numbered sequence.
- [`tabs`](#tabs): Tabbed panels of rich text or nested blocks (one level deep).
- [`table`](#table): Data table.
- [`contactForm`](#contactform): Contact form. Interactive only when the host app passes a submit handler.
- [`newsletterSignup`](#newslettersignup): Newsletter sign-up. Interactive only when the host app passes a submit handler.
- [`divider`](#divider): A horizontal rule between sections.
- [`spacer`](#spacer): Vertical space.

## Item shapes

### FeatureItemContent

An item in a feature grid.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `string` | no | Icon name from the library's icon set, e.g. "check". |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Short title. Guidance: under 50 characters. |
| `description` | `string` | no | One or two sentences. |
| `link` | `LinkRef` | no | Makes the title a link. |

### CardItemContent

A card.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Card title; becomes the card's single link when `link` is set. |
| `description` | `string` | no | Short text under the title. |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | no | Small label above the title, e.g. a category. |

A tab. Content is EITHER rich text OR nested blocks (one level only: no tabs inside tabs).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

## Shared types

From `src/content-types/shared.ts`. Navigation types (`NavItem`, `BreadcrumbItem`, `SocialLink`) and `Money` live in `navigation.ts` and `money.ts`.

### ImageRef

An image.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | yes | Image URL (relative path or http(s)). Never a data: URL. |
| `alt` | `string` | yes | Alternative text. Required; use "" only for purely decorative images. Guidance: under 150 characters. |
| `width` | `number` | no | Intrinsic width in pixels; with height, lets the browser reserve space. |
| `height` | `number` | no | Intrinsic height in pixels. |
| `srcSet` | `string` | no | Responsive sources, HTML srcset syntax. |
| `sizes` | `string` | no | HTML sizes attribute for srcSet. |
| `focalPoint` | `{ x: number; y: number }` | no | Point to keep in view when cropping, as fractions 0-1 from the top-left. |

### LinkRef

A link.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | yes | Visible link text. Guidance: under 60 characters. |
| `href` | `string` | yes | Relative path, #fragment, or an http(s), mailto: or tel: URL. javascript: and data: are refused. |
| `external` | `boolean` | no | Force external treatment (new-window safe rel, external icon). Defaults to true for absolute http(s) URLs. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name when the visible label is not descriptive enough on its own. |

### ActionRef

A link styled as a button. Extends `LinkRef`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost'` | no | Visual emphasis. Defaults depend on position (first action primary, second secondary). |

Allowed values: `variant`: `primary`, `secondary`, `ghost`.

### RichText

Formatted text. Only HTML is implemented today; the union leaves room for other formats. WARNING: THIS LIBRARY DOES NOT SANITIZE HTML. `html` is inserted into the page as-is. The adapter (or host app) MUST sanitize it with an allow-list of tags and attributes BEFORE producing a RichText value. The renderer only neutralizes unsafe URLs (javascript:, data: and similar link and image targets); it does not remove scripts, event handler attributes, styles or iframes.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `'html'` | yes | Format discriminator. |
| `html` | `string` | yes | Sanitized HTML using only: p, h2-h4, strong, em, a, ul, ol, li, blockquote, code, pre, br, hr, table elements, figure, img. |

### SeoMeta

Page metadata for <head>.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Document title. Guidance: under 60 characters. |
| `description` | `string` | no | Meta description. Guidance: 120-160 characters. |
| `canonicalUrl` | `string` | no | Absolute canonical URL. |
| `noindex` | `boolean` | no | Ask search engines not to index the page. |
| `ogImage` | `ImageRef` | no | Social sharing image. |
